title: User-bound authorization for cloud actions executed by AI agents
hypothesis: An agent using a shared cloud role without enforcing its initiating user's rights can execute an action denied to that user even when the workload role is correctly authorized.
null_hypothesis: Every action is authorized by both the user policy and agent workload policy.
novelty_review: known-class local mechanism study; exhaustive survey pending

tool.name: Agent user-permission gateway
tool.status: local prototype implemented; production adapter pending

local_hypothesis: A correctly privileged workload must also enforce the initiating user policy on the final action and resource in a user-bound execution contract.
hypothesis_evaluation: Constructed local mechanism supported; implementation-level and population claims not established.
